sections.title: Important
items: If your font in Home was Space Grotesk or split screen was turned off, this update switches the font to Original and turns split screen back on, once; you can change both again under Customization in Home.

sections.title: What's New
items: Split screen mode: press and hold an app on the taskbar to open it next to the one you're using, then tap Change order to swap sides.
Add websites to Home screen: use “Add to Home screen” in Chrome, Firefox or another browser to add a page to your app list, and hold it to remove it.
Revised taskbar: apps are right-aligned, a more responsive flick-up gesture closes an app, and closing the current app goes to Home instead of the next app.
Kindle on the power button: double-press the power button to open Kindle, even when the screen is locked; change this in Key Mapper.
Analog lock screen clocks: choose Plain, Flare, Window or Day in Customization > Wallpaper.
Your own wallpaper: tap Choose photo or video in Customization > Wallpaper.
Tutorial app: open Tutorial from your app list to go through the SolOS tutorial again.
Sidebar shortcuts: hold an app in the sidebar to see its shortcuts; you can still drag it to move it.
Adjustable start of the week: choose which day the week starts on in the mission control calendar.
Update notice: when an update is ready, a notice offers Remind me later and View update.
Preinstalled apps: apps you uninstall now stay uninstalled, and Niagara, Markup, Exchange and Reader can now be uninstalled too.

Quick swipe between apps (Experimental): swipe sideways along the bottom edge, the top edge or with five fingers to switch apps; it's off by default, so turn it on in Customization > Controls > Switch apps.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Add to sidebar adds several apps in one go, without reopening the menu.
The Home clock follows your 24-hour time setting and your chosen font.
The Brightness and Amber sliders change only when you drag them, to avoid accidental jumps; tap the icons at either end to adjust them a step at a time.
The Settings app is more responsive, and its pages open full screen again.
The Settings app follows dark mode.
In landscape mode, the lock screen shows the clock and notifications side by side.
Lock screen text is easier to read on any wallpaper.
App icons render better in grayscale.
Scrubbing through the A to Z letters is smoother.
Software Update asks before installing any update you start, and tells you when SolOS is updating and which version you're on afterwards.
Setup lets you show the password you typed, and tells you when a Wi-Fi network needs a sign-in or has no internet.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed a palm rejection bug that could cause occasional crashes while writing with the pen.
Fixed Settings closing when you open contactless payments.
Fixed Software Update closing when you open it in split screen.
Fixed Release Notes not opening from Software Update.
Fixed Google Meet getting stuck loading during its first-time setup.
Fixed the lock screen picture flashing after you enter your PIN; the screen now fades straight into Home.
Fixed a palm resting on the bottom edge opening the taskbar or switching apps while you write.
Fixed swiping up from the bottom edge to open the taskbar scrolling the open app.
Fixed Auto light/dark mode not switching when your tablet wakes from sleep.
Fixed the orange button waking your tablet or opening Note Overlay from sleep; wake your tablet first to use it, for example to take a snip.
Fixed Home showing the app list you left open when you come back to it.
Fixed a removed clock module not being addable back to the sidebar.
Fixed a Clear sidebar not staying clear in dark mode.
Fixed Setup's Wi-Fi step not recognizing the network you're already on.
Fixed pressing the power button during the tutorial putting your tablet to sleep.
